verdict.rationale: Fathom documents an official MCP server that connects meeting data to MCP-compatible tools like ChatGPT and Claude. The docs give a server URL with an authentication flow, an official Claude connector, and a Claude Code CLI command (`claude mcp add fathom ... https://api.fathom.ai/mcp`), and a probe confirms the MCP docs page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the server works as claimed, and documentation of which tools and data the server exposes.
